Senior UX designers should be strong communicators who are as much at ease talking to and working with senior executives as they are their own teammates. They can represent their team or the Design department at cross-functional company meetings and will be able to voice/present the Design position with clarity and precision. You are passionate about taking on complex design challenges meeting user needs and you enjoy working with the design team and teams across Canonical to deliver on the strategic vision for the company.


You will be working closely with other user experience and visual designers, front and back-end developers, and project management, as part of the design team, reporting to the Head of UX under the Design Director.


What you will be doing


You will be part of a team working on web applications for enterprise cloud services, IoT and embedded devices, bringing exciting new projects to life and improving existing ones.



• You will be leading your product-specific projects, driving design and delivery against agreed goals and working with designers, product management and engineering to deliver on the strategic vision for Canonical.


• You will plan and conduct research with target users and stakeholders from the business to identify and document users' needs and requirements as well as business requirements and KPIs


• You will manage incoming requests for work that affects you and needs to be considered (e.g. project briefs) and balance and prioritise the various projects’ requirements. In your day to day you are defining the scope, milestones and deliverables for any given iteration.


• You apply agile/lean project management methodologies. You will be the person resolving any blockers on your projects, through clear communication with project management and actively seeking help from team members, your manager and others.


• You will liaise with relevant stakeholders and engineers to achieve company goals, making time to talk via messaging applications, setting up and attending regular meetings, reviewing work with them in advance, sharing progress and seeking their input to achieve consensus and drive progress.


• We try as much as we can to share our experiences and knowledge within the team and to the community through informal presentations, the design blog and other events.


• Driving the adoption of Vanilla, our front end framework. You will be encouraging teammates to use or iterate existing patterns or when desired to design new patterns that are used across Canonical products and available as an open source resource.




Required Skills And Experience




• Ability to maintain a good view across a number of projects, and to be a go-to person for the design team as a whole and work with other seniors and leads to align overall departmental processes


• Ability to articulate clearly and effectively your design decisions to team members, engineers and stakeholders


• Ability to develop the process / approach for tackling a design problem and to lead the exploration and design solutions of undefined problem spaces


• Ability to set up, attend and run weekly catch-ups with engineers and stakeholders you are collaborating with


• Desire to work collaboratively with team members across different disciplines


• Ability to work in an agile way and manage your own workload to deliver designs to agreed timescales


• Motivation to drive understanding of impact and success metrics to focus your efforts. Develop a good working knowledge of KPI’s and Google Analytics - goal setting and tracking, A/B testing etc.


• Proficiency in design and prototyping tools and basic understanding of HTML and CSS


• Bachelor’s or master’s degrees or equivalent


• 5~7 years experience in UX design roles




What we offer



• Opportunity to help shape a company and products with strong influence in the open source community


• A fantastic work environment within a team of friendly people with a broad range of skill sets, from UX and visual designers to researchers and engineers


• Opportunity to create work that will potentially be seen by millions of people


• Remote role (EMEA time zone required) with good travel opportunities, predominantly to the US and Europe. Great benefits on offer too.


• Benefits package, including cycle to work scheme, pension scheme and health insurance

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI to help define the next generation of intelligent experiences across Intermedia's products.

In this role, you will design experiences that make artificial intelligence useful, intuitive, trustworthy, and approachable for business users. You will work at the intersection of UX strategy, interaction design, generative AI, conversational experiences, and enterprise software , turning sophisticated AI capabilities into simple experiences that solve real customer problems.

You will partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML teams, Engineering, Research, and other designers throughout the complete product lifecycle—from customer and market research through concepts, prototyping, development, launch, and post-launch analysis.

This is not simply a role for adding AI features to existing interfaces. You will help define how users interact with AI across our products , including copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, recommendations, summarization, intelligent automation, and agentic experiences.

Key Responsibilities
Responsibilities

AI Experience Design

• Design intuitive user experiences for AI-powered capabilities across web, desktop, mobile, and administrative interfaces.

• Explore new interaction models for generative AI, including conversational interfaces, copilots, AI assistants, intelligent recommendations, content generation, summarization, and AI-driven workflow automation.

• Design experiences for emerging agentic AI capabilities where AI systems can reason, recommend actions, execute tasks, and coordinate multi-step workflows on behalf of users.

• Translate complex AI functionality into simple, understandable interactions appropriate for everyday business users.

• Determine when AI should proactively assist users versus when users should explicitly initiate or control AI functionality.

• Design effective patterns for prompts, suggestions, generated content, AI actions, confirmations, feedback, and human intervention.

• Create experiences that communicate what an AI system is doing, why it made a recommendation, and what actions it has taken or intends to take.

UX & Product Design

• Own design initiatives from discovery and concept development through prototyping, implementation, launch, and post-launch optimization.

• Conduct user research, usability studies, interviews, competitive analysis, and workflow analysis to understand customer needs and behaviors.

• Translate customer problems and product requirements into user journeys, workflows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.

• Develop and validate design hypotheses through rapid prototyping and user testing.

• Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows through thoughtful UX and intelligent automation.

• Use qualitative and quantitative data to evaluate experiences and recommend improvements.

• Work closely with Product Management to ensure designs address meaningful customer problems and measurable business outcomes.

AI Trust & Responsible Design

• Design AI experiences that establish appropriate levels of trust, transparency, and user control .

• Clearly distinguish AI-generated information and actions where appropriate.

• Design graceful experiences for uncertainty, incomplete information, errors, hallucinations, and situations where the AI cannot confidently complete a request.

• Create effective confirmation, undo, escalation, and human-in-the-loop patterns for AI-driven actions.

• Design feedback mechanisms that allow users to evaluate, correct, or improve AI-generated results.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Privacy, and Legal teams to incorporate responsible AI principles into the user experience.

• Help establish UX guidelines for consistent and responsible use of AI throughout Intermedia products.

Design Systems

• Contribute to and evolve Intermedia's design system to support AI-powered experiences.

• Define reusable patterns and components for conversational interfaces, AI recommendations, generated content, AI actions, status indicators, feedback mechanisms, and agentic workflows.

• Ensure new AI capabilities integrate naturally with established product experiences rather than feeling like disconnected features.

• Maintain consistency across products while identifying where emerging AI interactions require new design paradigms.

• Partner with designers and developers to ensure design-system components are practical, scalable, accessible, and consistently implemented.

Collaboration & Leadership

• Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML engineers, software engineers, architects, researchers, and other designers.

• Facilitate design workshops and collaborative discovery sessions to explore customer problems and AI opportunities.

• Clearly communicate design rationale, research findings, user needs, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Challenge assumptions and advocate for customer-centered solutions when technology or implementation considerations begin driving the experience.

• Provide design leadership and mentorship to other designers and help raise the overall quality of UX across the organization.

• Collaborate effectively across multiple teams and product areas to create coherent end-to-end customer experiences.

• Stay current with emerging AI technologies, interaction patterns, and design practices and translate relevant developments into practical product experiences.

Our Expectations

• 5+ years of professional UI/UX, Product Design, or Interaction Design experience, ideally designing complex SaaS or enterprise software.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, complex workflows, interaction design, and thoughtful problem solving.

• Excellent knowledge of usability, UX/UI, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and human factors principles.

• Strong ability to analyze complex requirements and turn them into simple, elegant solutions.

• Experience conducting or participating in user research and usability testing.

• Strong proficiency with Figma , prototyping tools, and modern design-system practices.

• Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering in an Agile software-development environment.

• Strong communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to work effectively with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.

• Strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of the broader product and customer experience.

AI Experience & Knowledge

We don't expect you to be an AI engineer, but we do expect curiosity and practical fluency with modern AI technologies.

The ideal candidate has:

• Experience designing products or features powered by generative AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation.

• Understanding of large language models (LLMs) and the opportunities and limitations they introduce into product experiences.

• Familiarity with conversational UX and natural-language interfaces.

• Understanding of concepts such as prompts, context, AI-generated content, confidence and uncertainty, hallucinations, and AI feedback loops.

• Familiarity with AI agents and emerging patterns for designing systems that can perform multi-step actions on behalf of users.

• Experience thinking through trust, transparency, explainability, privacy, and user control in AI experiences.

• A strong interest in experimenting with new AI tools and interaction models.

Advantages

• Experience designing enterprise communications, collaboration, contact center, productivity, or workflow-automation products.

• Experience designing AI copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, or agentic workflows.

• Experience developing or contributing to large-scale design systems.

• Experience with voice and multimodal interfaces.

• Understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design.

• Familiarity with HTML/CSS and the technical constraints of modern web applications.

• Experience using AI-assisted design and prototyping tools.

• Experience working with globally distributed Product and Engineering teams.

What Success Looks Like

As a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI, you will help ensure that AI at Intermedia is not simply powerful technology—it is a valuable and trusted customer experience .

Success means:

• Customers immediately understand how AI can help them.

• Complex AI capabilities feel simple and natural to use.

• Users remain informed and in control when AI recommends or takes actions.

• AI features integrate seamlessly into existing customer workflows.

• Common AI interaction patterns become consistent across Intermedia products.

• Research and customer feedback meaningfully influence AI product decisions.

• Product and Engineering teams view Design as a strategic partner in determining what AI experiences should be built , not simply how they should look.

Ultimately, you will help establish the design language and interaction principles that shape how customers experience AI across Intermedia's portfolio.

Join product discussions early and help shape the problem before screens are made.

Cover key states, edge cases and handoff details, then stay involved during implementation.

Increase the share of design work that can move into production without another rework round.

Strong UI craft and a portfolio of clear, thoughtful interfaces.

jd.80dbd1911cf44991:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI to help define the next generation of intelligent experiences across Intermedia's products.

In this role, you will design experiences that make artificial intelligence useful, intuitive, trustworthy, and approachable for business users. You will work at the intersection of UX strategy, interaction design, generative AI, conversational experiences, and enterprise software , turning sophisticated AI capabilities into simple experiences that solve real customer problems.

You will partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML teams, Engineering, Research, and other designers throughout the complete product lifecycle—from customer and market research through concepts, prototyping, development, launch, and post-launch analysis.

This is not simply a role for adding AI features to existing interfaces. You will help define how users interact with AI across our products , including copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, recommendations, summarization, intelligent automation, and agentic experiences.

Key Responsibilities
AI Experience Design

• Design intuitive user experiences for AI-powered capabilities across web, desktop, mobile, and administrative interfaces.

• Explore new interaction models for generative AI, including conversational interfaces, copilots, AI assistants, intelligent recommendations, content generation, summarization, and AI-driven workflow automation.

• Design experiences for emerging agentic AI capabilities where AI systems can reason, recommend actions, execute tasks, and coordinate multi-step workflows on behalf of users.

• Translate complex AI functionality into simple, understandable interactions appropriate for everyday business users.

• Determine when AI should proactively assist users versus when users should explicitly initiate or control AI functionality.

• Design effective patterns for prompts, suggestions, generated content, AI actions, confirmations, feedback, and human intervention.

• Create experiences that communicate what an AI system is doing, why it made a recommendation, and what actions it has taken or intends to take.

UX & Product Design

• Own design initiatives from discovery and concept development through prototyping, implementation, launch, and post-launch optimization.

• Conduct user research, usability studies, interviews, competitive analysis, and workflow analysis to understand customer needs and behaviors.

• Translate customer problems and product requirements into user journeys, workflows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.

• Develop and validate design hypotheses through rapid prototyping and user testing.

• Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows through thoughtful UX and intelligent automation.

• Use qualitative and quantitative data to evaluate experiences and recommend improvements.

• Work closely with Product Management to ensure designs address meaningful customer problems and measurable business outcomes.

AI Trust & Responsible Design

• Design AI experiences that establish appropriate levels of trust, transparency, and user control .

• Clearly distinguish AI-generated information and actions where appropriate.

• Design graceful experiences for uncertainty, incomplete information, errors, hallucinations, and situations where the AI cannot confidently complete a request.

• Create effective confirmation, undo, escalation, and human-in-the-loop patterns for AI-driven actions.

• Design feedback mechanisms that allow users to evaluate, correct, or improve AI-generated results.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Privacy, and Legal teams to incorporate responsible AI principles into the user experience.

• Help establish UX guidelines for consistent and responsible use of AI throughout Intermedia products.

Design Systems

• Contribute to and evolve Intermedia's design system to support AI-powered experiences.

• Define reusable patterns and components for conversational interfaces, AI recommendations, generated content, AI actions, status indicators, feedback mechanisms, and agentic workflows.

• Ensure new AI capabilities integrate naturally with established product experiences rather than feeling like disconnected features.

• Maintain consistency across products while identifying where emerging AI interactions require new design paradigms.

• Partner with designers and developers to ensure design-system components are practical, scalable, accessible, and consistently implemented.

Collaboration & Leadership

• Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML engineers, software engineers, architects, researchers, and other designers.

• Facilitate design workshops and collaborative discovery sessions to explore customer problems and AI opportunities.

• Clearly communicate design rationale, research findings, user needs, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Challenge assumptions and advocate for customer-centered solutions when technology or implementation considerations begin driving the experience.

• Provide design leadership and mentorship to other designers and help raise the overall quality of UX across the organization.

• Collaborate effectively across multiple teams and product areas to create coherent end-to-end customer experiences.

• Stay current with emerging AI technologies, interaction patterns, and design practices and translate relevant developments into practical product experiences.

Our Expectations

• 5+ years of professional UI/UX, Product Design, or Interaction Design experience, ideally designing complex SaaS or enterprise software.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, complex workflows, interaction design, and thoughtful problem solving.

• Excellent knowledge of usability, UX/UI, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and human factors principles.

• Strong ability to analyze complex requirements and turn them into simple, elegant solutions.

• Experience conducting or participating in user research and usability testing.

• Strong proficiency with Figma , prototyping tools, and modern design-system practices.

• Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering in an Agile software-development environment.

• Strong communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to work effectively with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.

• Strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of the broader product and customer experience.

AI Experience & Knowledge

We don't expect you to be an AI engineer, but we do expect curiosity and practical fluency with modern AI technologies.

The ideal candidate has:

• Experience designing products or features powered by generative AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation.

• Understanding of large language models (LLMs) and the opportunities and limitations they introduce into product experiences.

• Familiarity with conversational UX and natural-language interfaces.

• Understanding of concepts such as prompts, context, AI-generated content, confidence and uncertainty, hallucinations, and AI feedback loops.

• Familiarity with AI agents and emerging patterns for designing systems that can perform multi-step actions on behalf of users.

• Experience thinking through trust, transparency, explainability, privacy, and user control in AI experiences.

• A strong interest in experimenting with new AI tools and interaction models.

Advantages

• Experience designing enterprise communications, collaboration, contact center, productivity, or workflow-automation products.

• Experience designing AI copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, or agentic workflows.

• Experience developing or contributing to large-scale design systems.

• Experience with voice and multimodal interfaces.

• Understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design.

• Familiarity with HTML/CSS and the technical constraints of modern web applications.

• Experience using AI-assisted design and prototyping tools.

• Experience working with globally distributed Product and Engineering teams.

What Success Looks Like

As a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI, you will help ensure that AI at Intermedia is not simply powerful technology—it is a valuable and trusted customer experience .

Success means:

• Customers immediately understand how AI can help them.

• Complex AI capabilities feel simple and natural to use.

• Users remain informed and in control when AI recommends or takes actions.

• AI features integrate seamlessly into existing customer workflows.

• Common AI interaction patterns become consistent across Intermedia products.

• Research and customer feedback meaningfully influence AI product decisions.

• Product and Engineering teams view Design as a strategic partner in determining what AI experiences should be built , not simply how they should look.

Ultimately, you will help establish the design language and interaction principles that shape how customers experience AI across Intermedia's portfolio.

Description

Trouva is one of the fastest growing tech businesses in Europe ( TNW Tech5 ), one of Wired Magazine's hottest European Startups and is 1st in the prestigious Startups 100 Index , ranking the UK’s best high growth startups.

A software-enabled marketplace, Trouva brings customers beautiful homewares from the best independent boutiques around the world. We’re building a different kind of e-commerce experience, driven by discovery and inspiration. Using cutting edge technology, Trouva harnesses the expertise of the best bricks-and-mortar shops from Shoreditch to Stockholm, and scales their offering online to connect with a global customer base seeking unique, hard-to-find homewares.

Backed by world-leading investors, we’re growing incredibly quickly and are looking for exceptional people to join the Trouva family. Get a feel for what we're about through our Instagram or vision page !

THE OPPORTUNITY

Trouva is hiring a Senior Product Designer to work across both our consumer and back-office products that make the world’s best boutique’s goods available online through our website and our new iOS app. The role is based out of our Lisbon office though we’re open to partially remote; we think it’s important for the team to be able to come together once or twice a week.

Product designers at Trouva are fascinated by the entire design process - from research to user interface design. Whilst each person tends to have more in-depth expertise in some areas than others, what we all share is a desire to become excellent all-round designers. Most of your time will be spent working with the product manager and software engineers in your cross-functional squad.

A typical week might look like:

• Work with PMs to articulate the most pressing outcomes we need to deliver

• Plan generative or evaluative research, help moderate the sessions and analyse the results

• Facilitate an ideation workshop to harness the whole team’s creativity. Then bring it all together into a coherent solution that can be prototyped and evaluated quickly

• Create beautiful UI utilising our existing web design system where appropriate

• Take part in our regular design team critique sessions where we support each other to our best work

• Present your work to stakeholders in the wider company

• Communicate your designs to devs and then work with them to design practical solutions to implement

Requirements

Before we tell you about what we’re looking for, this is a senior position so we do expect you to have good experience doing much of what follows. However, just to be clear, we don’t expect you to tick all of these boxes. If you’re a talented designer who can knock this job out the park, then show us your portfolio! We’re especially keen to hear from people with diverse backgrounds.

• You’ll be obsessed with typography, imagery, layout, and colour and how they can be used to tell a compelling story to our users

• You can eloquently and persuasively articulate why you designed something the way you did and are equally comfortable explaining that rationale to senior management as you are to other designers and engineers

• You’re intelligent, passionate about design, and endlessly curious. Your craving to learn new things is only outweighed by your urge to share your knowledge with others. You’re naturally observant and that awareness means you’re forever spotting ways to improve the world around you

• You see yourself as a maker. You move quickly and are creative of course but you also have a healthy dose of pragmatism that compels you towards getting things shipped and in front of users.

• You work well with engineers and can understand the limitations of digital products, whilst still pushing at those boundaries

• Being a great designer at Trouva is about driving people towards your vision of a better shopping experience. Your optimism will help you realize that vision

• You are keen to connect with our users (both shoppers and boutique owners) to understand the motivations behind their behaviours and so create experiences that move beyond mere problem solving and engage them on an emotional level

• You’re friendly, humble and approachable but also have the courage and principles to back your designs whilst taking onboard contrary evidence. In short, you have strong opinions, weakly held

• This role reports into the VP Design. The design team works across product, brand and marketing to create coherent, delightful experiences

• Skills in motion design would be a lovely bonus too

Perks

• Competitive salary

• 25 days holiday + bank holidays, plus a 'recoup and revive' day to use every 6 months

• Quarterly Wellness perks

• Competitive family and compassionate leave policies

• Flexible remote working policy

• Regular team events where we celebrate our success and people

• Need tech or equipment? We'll provide you with everything you need to get the job done

• Unlimited staff discount on all Trouva products and a Trouva gift card to get something awesome for your desk.

Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.

The Opportunity at Altana

Altana's mission is to fix globalization. We are building a network that brings together public and private sector entities, across myriad workflows from customs and transaction processing, to macro policy analysis, to supply chain resilience. Combined with the age of agents and AI native experience this isn’t something the SaaS playbook has prepared us for. As Head of Design you will shape the product vision of Altana and bring it to life. You will create a consistent, agent-first design system for handling a wide array of information-dense, complex workflows across governments, logistics providers, importers, and their suppliers across a range of use cases.

And you need to lean into the evolving role of product design in an AI-native software development lifecycle. Traditional design organizations are not set up for this world. They scale linearly with headcount, ship Figma files to engineers as the unit of work, treat the design system as a component library, and assume the user is a single human clicking through a single product. That model is already breaking. Product managers can prototype in working code. Engineers can generate full interfaces from a prompt. Customers increasingly interact with the product through an agent that reasons, summarizes, and acts on their behalf. The center of gravity for how experiences get made is shifting — and the design organizations that thrive next will not be the ones that draw the most screens. Our head of design is expected to help us create this new world and evolve traditional SDLC’s to tighten the feedback loop, and produce more output faster together in a native AI loop.

We are looking for a Head of Design to build Altana's design organization for that world from the ground up: an agent-first design team whose primary deliverable is not a static mockup but a living design system — a structured, semantic, machine-readable language of patterns, components, primitives, and interaction grammars that PMs, engineers, and AI agents can compose against to ship coherent, on-brand, high-quality experiences without a designer in the critical path of every screen. You will redefine what it means to design an in-product experience when the user on the other side is sometimes a customs broker, sometimes a Fortune 500 trade compliance team, sometimes a sovereign government analyst, and increasingly, sometimes an AI agent acting on their behalf. You will treat AI not as a feature you bolt onto the UI but as a native participant in every workflow — with its own surfaces, affordances, failure modes, and trust signals — and you will build the design language that makes human-and-agent collaboration feel obvious instead of awkward.

This is a role for a leader who is as much a product thinker as a design thinker. You will sit at the same table as the product leaders, the CPO, CTO, CEO and Head of Engineering, set strategy alongside them, and own outcomes — not just artifacts.

What You'll Do

Build an Agent-First Design Organization

• Define what an agent-first design team looks like in practice — how it's structured, what it ships, what it measures, and how it scales with leverage rather than headcount.

• Hire, develop, and lead a team of designers who treat AI as a teammate and a medium: who prototype in code with AI assistance, who design with agents rather than around them, and who see the design system as the team's highest-leverage product.

• Establish the rituals, review forums, and quality bars that keep a small team of designers accountable for the experience of a multi-product, multi-persona network — without becoming the bottleneck that slows it down.

• Champion a culture of "show, don't tell": working prototypes, agent-generated variants, and live demos beat decks and static comps every time.

Make the Design System the Product

• Own the vision for Altana's design system as the enablement layer for a new class of creators — product managers, engineers, and AI agents — who increasingly build user-facing experiences directly.

• Define the system as more than a component library: a structured set of patterns, tokens, content rules, interaction grammars, and accessibility guarantees that are semantic , composable , and legible to AI — so that an LLM generating a workflow, a PM prototyping a new view, or an engineer wiring up a feature all converge on the same coherent experience.

• Build the contribution model, the documentation, and the tooling (including AI-native authoring and review tools) that make the design system the fastest, easiest, and highest-quality path to ship — not a checklist people work around.

• Measure the design system by leverage: how many net-new experiences shipped without direct designer involvement still meet the bar; how fast new patterns propagate; how much rework the system prevents.

Design Agent-Native In-Product Experiences

• Evolve Altana's in-product experience from a set of human-only workflows to genuinely agent-native workflows — where agents act, explain, ask, and hand off to humans, and humans confirm, correct, escalate, and delegate back.

• Define the visual and interaction language for the new primitives this requires: agent reasoning surfaces, provenance and citation patterns, confidence and uncertainty signals, interruption and consent moments, multi-step task previews, human-in-the-loop review queues, and the affordances that let a user trust — or appropriately distrust — what an agent has done on their behalf.

• Partner with product and engineering to make agentic capability discoverable inside the existing product, not hidden behind a separate "AI" tab — so that the right capability shows up at the right step of the workflow, for the right persona.

• Treat every agent surface as a first-class design problem: what it looks like when it's working, what it looks like when it's wrong, and how a user moves between agent-mediated and direct-manipulation modes without losing their place.

Design Across a Multi-Product, Multi-Persona Network

• Own the end-to-end design strategy for a product suite that spans enterprise supply chain mapping, customs and entry management, PLM/ERP integration, government and regulatory tooling, logistics provider workflows, and financial services use cases — all converging on a single network experience.

• Design for personas that share objects but not mental models: a corporate trade compliance officer, a licensed customs broker, a CBP officer, a logistics dispatcher, a supplier in a developing market, and an AI agent acting for any of them — collaborating around the same Product Passport, the same shipment, the same risk signal.

• Build a design system that is opinionated about coherence but flexible about persona — one navigation, one visual language, one set of patterns — modulated by role, surface, and use case rather than forked into product-specific silos.

• Make collaboration a first-class design surface: shared workspaces, handoffs across organizations, comments and approvals that cross enterprise/broker/government boundaries, and the trust and access patterns that make those interactions safe.

Lead as a Product Thinker, Not Just a Design Thinker

• Operate as a peer to Product, Engineering, and Data Science leadership: shape strategy, make trade-offs, own outcomes against business and network metrics — not just craft and aesthetics.

• Tie design investment directly to the metrics that matter for a network business: activation, time-to-value, workflow completion, multi-party adoption, network k-factor, and product-led expansion across personas and organizations.

• Lead customer research and discovery as a strategic capability — not a service function — and use what you learn to influence what gets built, not just how it looks.

• Translate design vision into a clear, compelling narrative that aligns the executive team, the board, customers, and prospective hires around why design is a competitive moat for Altana.

Partner Across the Company

• Partner deeply with Engineering on the design-to-code pipeline: shared primitives, AI-assisted generation, automated accessibility and visual regression, and a contribution model where front-end engineers extend the system as a matter of course.

• Partner with Product on roadmap and discovery — designing in the open with prototypes, not gating it behind handoff rituals.

• Partner with Customer Experience, Marketing, and Sales to ensure that the product experience, the documentation that AI agents consume, and the way Altana communicates change all speak in one coherent voice.

Who You Are

You think in systems, not screens. You don't just want to design great surfaces — you want to design the system that produces great surfaces at scale, in the hands of people who don't have "designer" in their title. You see the design system as your team's highest-leverage product and you have built one that was actually used as such.

You're agent-native, not AI-curious. You actively use AI tools to do your own work — to research, prototype, generate variants, critique, and ship. You have opinions about what agent-native UX looks like, formed by building it, not by reading about it. You're not waiting for "the AI design wave" — you've been on it for a while, and you have the receipts.

You're a product thinker as much as a design thinker. You can sit in a strategy session and make a credible case for what to build and why, not only how. You understand business and network metrics, can read a usage funnel, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes — activation, adoption, retention, expansion — not just to craft and aesthetics.

You design for many users at once. You're comfortable optimizing a single design system across radically different personas — enterprise compliance officers, government regulators, brokers, suppliers, agents — who all collaborate inside the same network experience. You know how to keep an experience coherent without flattening the differences between the people using it.

You're a builder, not just a leader. You can still prototype. You still review the work. You still write the principles. You build leverage for your team by raising the floor of the design system, not by becoming a bottleneck above it.

You're technically fluent. You don't need to ship production code, but you're comfortable in the materials of the modern web: CSS, React, design tokens, component APIs, accessibility primitives, and the AI tools that increasingly sit between a design intent and a shipped pixel. You can have a real conversation with engineering about how the system is implemented, not just how it looks.

You communicate with clarity and conviction. You can present design strategy to a CEO, a customer, a board, a prospective hire, and a junior designer — and each of them walks away aligned. You write as well as you draw.

You're energized by hard problems and high stakes. Altana's design surface — a multi-product, multi-persona, agent-native network that mediates real-world global trade — is one of the more interesting design challenges in enterprise software today. You see that as a feature, not a bug.

Preferred Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in product or UX design, including 4+ years leading design organizations in complex, multi-product B2B or enterprise SaaS environments.

• A portfolio that demonstrates ownership of a design system — not just a set of screens — that was actively used by non-designers (engineers, PMs, and ideally AI tooling) to ship production experiences.

• Demonstrated experience designing AI-mediated or agentic in-product experiences — including the patterns for trust, provenance, confidence, human-in-the-loop review, and graceful failure.

• Experience designing across multiple personas and organizations that share workflows — collaborative SaaS, multi-sided platforms, marketplaces, or network products.

• Strong product instincts: comfortable owning outcomes against business and network metrics (activation, time-to-value, adoption, k-factor, PQLs), not just design quality metrics.

• Hands-on fluency with modern AI tools as part of your own design and prototyping practice — using them to generate, critique, prototype, and accelerate, not just to admire.

• Technical fluency with the design-to-code surface: tokens, component APIs, CSS, React (or willingness to learn), accessibility standards, and the tooling that connects design systems to production code.

• Experience designing data-dense, decision-support, or analytical experiences — supply chain visualizations, knowledge graphs, dashboards, regulatory workflows — is a strong plus.

• Experience in a high-growth, zero-to-one environment where you had to build the design organization while running it.

Director Product Design

Europe / Remote
Reports to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer

About Velsera

Velsera builds software that turns complex biological data into research insight and clinical answers. Our platforms work across multi-omic and multi-modal data: genomics alongside proteomics, transcriptomics and other omics, together with imaging, clinical and real-world data, at the scale of some of the world's largest biomedical programs. Pharmaceutical companies, biotechs, public research initiatives and diagnostic laboratories use our products to advance precision medicine.

We run like a scale-up: small teams with real authority, fast decisions, and AI woven into how we work day to day. We measure ourselves on impact for our customers and, ultimately, for patients.

The opportunity

You'd be joining as the design authority for our Seven Bridges Platform and the leader of design at Velsera, just as we rebuild how we design, validate and ship. You report directly to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer, and decisions that take quarters elsewhere happen here in days. Our product managers have already started turning ideas into working, on-brand prototypes with AI and put them in front of customers within weeks. The design foundations that make that speed safe are yours to build and own: design tokens, a component library, and the patterns everyone works with.

That's the shape of your influence here. Product managers prototype with the system you build, you review what customers will see, and once a concept is validated, production design belongs to you: journeys that hold up across every state, edge case and installation. This is a product bioinformaticians, scientists and clinicians rely on every day, and you set its bar.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll manage our product designer working on the clinical side of our portfolio, you'll build the design function as it grows, and you'll keep doing the craft yourself. There's no large design team to inherit; there's one to create.

The product is changing as fast as the craft is. Our users increasingly work alongside AI in research and diagnostic workflows, with dense, high-stakes data from many sources. Someone needs to rethink the journeys, trust models and information design of software like ours for that reality. That is a key remit of this job.

This role won't suit everyone. If you're looking for a mature design organization with settled processes, you won't find that here yet. If you want to build the system a whole company designs with, lead design for products with real clinical stakes, and do it at scale-up speed, we should talk.

What will you do?

• Own the user journeys, flows and interaction design of the Seven Bridges Platform: partner with product managers on problems, outcomes and scope, then own how the experience actually works, from structure and states down to the number of clicks.

• Build our design system from the ground up: design tokens, a component library aligned with our front-end code, and the standards that bring our product surfaces together under one visual language. The whole organization will prototype with what you build.

• Keep rapid prototyping fast and safe: maintain the foundations PMs build with, review prototype quality before customers see it, and take validated prototypes through to production-ready design.

• Manage our product designer on the clinical side: set goals, develop their craft, give honest feedback, and answer for the quality of design across both businesses. As the team grows, you'll hire and shape it.

• Design for AI in the product itself: assistant and copilot experiences, AI-generated results that scientists and clinicians can trust and verify, and workflows where automation and human judgment work together.

• Work closely with front-end engineers so the design system lives in code, not only in Figma.

• Use product analytics to see where users struggle, make experience debt visible, and give product leadership a clear case for what to fix first.

• Bring design judgment into strategy conversations at the leadership level.

Your first few months

The first version of the design system is live, with tokens and core components in Figma and in code, and product managers are actually prototyping on top of it. You've reviewed working prototypes before they went in front of real customers, and what we shipped is better for it. You and the designer you manage have a real working rhythm, with clear goals and honest feedback, and it shows in the work. And your map of our experience debt is on the leadership table with a clear case for what to fix first.

Requirements

What do you bring to the table?

You've spent seven or more years in product design, with senior ownership of user journeys on complex, data-heavy or scientific software.

• You've built or led at least one design system that engineering genuinely adopted, and you know what it takes to keep one alive.

• You've managed designers formally, not just mentored them, and the people you've managed got better and would work for you again.

• You're comfortable having your biggest impact through a system other people build with, not only through screens you designed yourself.

• You've chosen fast, ambiguous environments before, and you're looking for another one.

• You already use AI tools to design, prototype and produce working software (we work with Claude, from design exploration through design-to-code), and you have well-formed opinions about where these tools help and where they mislead.

• You've designed AI-powered product experiences, or you have a clear point of view on trust, transparency and human oversight in AI interfaces.

• You're an expert in Figma, including variables and design-to-code workflows such as Code Connect.

• You know enough front-end to collaborate credibly with engineers on components and constraints. You don't need to write production code, but you do need to understand how your designs become it.

• You can operate as the most senior design voice in the company: comfortable with ambiguity, generous as a coach, and clear whether you're talking to executives, engineers or scientists.

Nice to have: experience with genomics, multi-omics, imaging, clinical or other life sciences data products, or another regulated domain; products delivered across multiple environments or installations; familiarity with component documentation tools like Storybook; experience establishing design practice in an engineering-led organization.

Why this position?

You get real authority over a core product and the design function itself, from day one, with a direct line to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer. You join a company that works the way it's asking you to work: AI-assisted, fast and hands-on. The work ends in research results and patient outcomes, which makes the pace worth it. And you won't inherit a design practice here; you'll build the one everyone after you inherits.

Benefits

• Flexible Work & Time Off - Embrace hybrid work models and enjoy the freedom of unlimited paid time off to support work-life balance.

• Health & Well-being - Access comprehensive group medical and life insurance coverage, along with a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health and wellness support.

• Growth & Learning - Fuel your professional journey with continuous learning and development programs designed to help you upskill and grow.

• Engaging & Fun Work Culture - Experience a vibrant workplace with team events, celebrations, and engaging activities that make every workday enjoyable.

Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

More about our mission and what we offer .

Job Description

Your mission

You’ll explore how to harness the potential of AI to scale your impact as a designer. You’ll quickly test and iterate on your ideas with a high degree of freedom and flexibility, learning as part of your day-to-day work as the technology evolves.

You’ll shape the core Wise Assistant experience for Support and beyond. You’ll design the system that guides our customers through every part of the Wise product, giving them quick and reliable help exactly when they need it. Together with your technical partners, you’ll architect and design agents, own prompts, and define how context and knowledge are used to resolve real customer problems.

This role will sit within the Content Design Guild as part of our Design team, as the disciplines share a common skill set and design process.

How you’ll contribute:

• Together with a team of engineers, product managers, and data scientists, you’ll design the systems that enable Wise to deliver conversational AI experiences that help customers at the exact moment they need support.

• You’ll collaborate with partners across engineering, data science, product, and design to set the vision and strategy, and coach teams to deliver it.

• You’ll shape agent behaviour, define how components of the system interact, and own prompts, reasoning, and context.

• You’ll be influential within your product area, identifying and prioritising system needs and delivering the most impactful projects across multiple teams.

• Using your expertise, you’ll raise design maturity and deepen the Support squad’s understanding of context engineering.

• As part of the Content Design Guild, you’ll regularly collaborate with Wise’s wider content community. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to partner with other Model and Content Designers to evolve how we approach working with AI as designers.

This role will give you the opportunity to:

• Own the squad’s automation strategy end to end and steer its direction.

• Champion quality for our customers—you’ll define what good looks like within the squad and demonstrate it through everything you ship.

• Be part of a positive change in the world. We’re fixing a broken system and putting people and businesses in control of their money.

About you:

• You’re an accomplished and experienced Model Designer, or a systems-focused Content Designer who has already made this transition in your day-to-day work. You bring extensive experience in designing large, complex automation systems that deliver exceptional experiences to customers.

• You have an in-depth understanding of AI and strong perspectives on how its underpinning systems should be shaped, both within user-facing products and as part of the design process.

• You’ve designed systems that generate content and experiences to guide customers, including prompts, guardrails, knowledge architecture, and agents.

• You love learning new things, nerding out on technical details, and applying what you learn to solve complex problems.

• You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and collaborating successfully in this kind of environment. You learn quickly and put what you learn into practice.

• You have an eye for quality and know where to focus to improve it.

• You’re influential and inspiring, and you work well with others in a culture that values autonomy and empowerment. You champion the role of model design and content design in automation-based projects and enjoy coaching designers who are new to these kinds of products.

• You’re highly empathetic, both towards customers and the people you work with.

Heads up: this probably isn’t for you if:

You haven’t previously worked hands-on with a large-scale automated system. This role requires a high level of technical expertise and the ability to partner as an equal with data scientists and engineers when designing large, complex AI systems. You should already have a strong working knowledge of common prompt-engineering techniques and frameworks, context engineering, and agentic design.

Your experience is mostly in marketing content, advertising, copywriting, journalism, or social media, and you have no hands-on experience in model design, content design, or UX.

You’re not comfortable navigating complexity or working in a fast-paced environment.

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs .

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram .

Our flexible work philosophy

Flexibility at Squarespace isn’t new and all roles at Squarespace are flexible in one way or another. Before the pandemic, Squarespace embraced flexible work - 13% of our employees were fully remote, while most in-office employees had flexible schedules.

As we look to the future of work, we are increasing our existing flexibility. We believe that flexibility increases productivity and satisfaction, decreases our carbon footprint related to commuting, and enables us to attract and retain a more diverse and inclusive workforce.

Squarespace’s Flexible Work Policy outlines two distinct work classifications - Officespace and Homespace - designed to help foster an inclusive and collaborative environment. In the same way that there isn’t a one size fits all solution for our customers, there isn’t a one size fits all approach that will work for every individual and every role. So we have empowered individuals, their managers, and department leaders to determine the appropriate approach to flexible work for them. The type of flexibility needed will vary based on the role - with consideration for whether the role needs to have face to face collaboration and interaction, and the ability for that role to be done remotely vs. in the office.

1. Officespace - employees who spend at least some of their week working from a Squarespace office location. Each Officespace employee’s work schedule is agreed upon between them and their manager and approved by their department head, with some being fully in-office and some having flexible schedules. Depending on their role and how often they are in the office, some Officespace employees will have assigned desks while others will participate in hoteling of desk space.

2. Homespace - employees who spend all or the majority of their time working remotely and do not have a desk in a Squarespace office. Fully remote positions are currently available for designated roles at department discretion.

We also embrace the benefits of face to face interaction and collaboration, so curating an enticing office experience remains part of our Squarespace approach. Our office is so much more than a place people go to work. Each of our offices has been built to inspire creativity and foster community. It’s more than a workplace. We invite all who enter to find a space that feels their own. It’s a collective. It’s our space.

Whether you have a Officespace or Homespace workstyle, we aspire to foster collaboration and connection between everyone at Squarespace.

Perks & benefits

Relax, we’ve got you covered.

We take care of our employees in more ways than one. Our comprehensive benefits offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their dependent children. We also offer up to 20 weeks of paid family leave (or local equivalent), fertility and adoption benefits, and behavioral health and wellness programs such as Headspace and more.

Work-life balance.

We view our people as professionals with interests, responsibilities and passions outside of work. And we believe employees need quality time to unplug and recharge for their own well-being and satisfaction. Through our flexible PTO policy, we encourage team members to take the time off they need to recharge and be their best. We also encourage the creator and entrepreneur in all of our employees by offering two free Squarespace sites and a complimentary subscription to Unfold to pursue their creative passions.

Stay informed.

We’re dedicated to ensuring all employees have the information they need to stay connected to each other and to do their jobs well. Our annual company kick-off, quarterly all hands meetings, year-end wrap up, collaborative Slack channels, and newsletters are just a few of the ways we bring our employees together and share key aspects of the business across the entire organization.

We value our people.

We’re serious about investing in our people and sharing in Squarespace’s successes. As part of our total rewards programming, we offer qualifying employees equity in the company and competitive retirement programs (e.g., 401(k), pension) with a company match.

We give back.

Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Team & Role:

At ServiceNow, we embrace representation in and from all professional and personal backgrounds and cultures. This diversity inspires passion and creativity among our teams and propels innovation in our products. This role is part of our Product Design team that uses their superpower of empathizing, understanding, and applying our users’ and customers’ needs, with the mission to created product experiences they love. Our designers come from a diverse set of skills and background - design systems, visual, interaction, content, and product design. At ServiceNow, design has a very intentional seat at the table, so our team collaborates closely with both engineering and product management from the get-go.

Learn more about our team here: https://www.linkedin.com/company/servicenow/life/userexperience/

This is not a standard product design role. Designing for content at this scale requires fluency in large-scale content architecture, fragmented content libraries, structured content systems, cross-property consolidation, and AI-mediated retrieval design. This requires a practitioner who specializes in owning the customer's experience of finding, navigating, and using content across dozens of sources, teams, and systems.

Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications:

•
8+ years in digital product design with strong expertise in both B2B SaaS and B2C design

•
Proven ability to design complex information architectures and UX systems serving diverse audiences (learners, admins, community members)

•
Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design strategy from narrative development through high-fidelity execution

•
Demonstrated design leadership leading teams through rapid iteration, managing feedback loops, and maintaining quality amid parallel workstreams

•
Ability to articulate UX architecture frameworks that translate platform conventions into cohesive adjacent web experiences

•
Strategic communicator who presents design thinking to senior stakeholders, refines scope through clarifying questions, and advocates for user-centered approaches

•
Ability to synthesize research insights and user feedback into actionable design direction and vision refinements

•
Mastery of Figma and collaborative design workflows at scale; experience navigating matrixed organizations with competing priorities

•
Comfortable with evolving priorities, dual-track workstreams, and the ambiguity inherent in transformational product initiatives

•
Preferred: experience with learning platforms, AI-native design patterns, multi-property experience consolidation, or brand-driven design systems

Basic Qualifications:

•
BA/BS degree or higher in Design, Design Communication, Human-Computer Interaction, or equivalent combination of education and experience in other related fields

•
Experience participating in the complete product development lifecycle of web and/or software applications

•
Experience in user experience design or industry experience (corporate, software, web or agency)

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $149,800 - $262,200 , plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here . To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Design Engineer - Creative Studio based in Ireland.

Join a high-velocity engineering environment building the next generation of AI-powered creative products.
You’ll help shape intuitive, expressive interfaces for image, video, music, audiobook, and agentic creation experiences.
The role combines strong frontend engineering skills with product thinking, UX sensitivity, and visual craftsmanship.
You’ll own features end to end, from early concepts and prototypes through development, iteration, and launch.
You’ll collaborate closely with Design, Engineering, Growth, and Sales to solve meaningful customer and business problems.
With significant autonomy and flexibility, you’ll influence both product direction and the technical solutions behind it.
You’ll also help raise the bar for the team by mentoring other frontend-focused engineers and contributing to a culture of excellence.

Accountabilities

• Build and maintain creative products and platform experiences used by millions of users, with a strong focus on frontend development and user experience.

• Design and develop intuitive UX/UI workflows for AI-powered creative experiences, including image generation, video, music, audiobooks, and agentic creation.

• Take ownership of end-to-end features across the full stack, from scoping and prototyping through implementation, launch, and iteration.

• Help define the product and development direction for the features and experiences you own.

• Develop new proof-of-concept products, including solutions created directly with partner customers, with potential to scale into new markets.

• Improve existing products through UX enhancements, new functionality, integrations, and thoughtful adoption of emerging AI capabilities.

• Collaborate closely with Design, Engineering, Growth, and Sales to create cohesive web experiences and solve customer and internal workflow challenges.

• Execute and iterate on designs using user feedback, product insights, and web development best practices.

• Contribute to reliable, performant, secure, and scalable internal infrastructure as products and usage grow.

• Mentor less experienced frontend-leaning engineers and contribute to engineering standards and knowledge sharing.

• Contribute to the collection, management, and processing of large-scale datasets supporting the development of next-generation generative AI models.

Requirements

• Professional experience as a frontend engineer with a strong eye for design, visual quality, and user experience.

• Strong proficiency in Next.js, React, and TypeScript, with hands-on experience building modern web applications.

• Experience using design and animation libraries such as Shadcn, Framer Motion, D3, or comparable tools.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating web projects and the ability to create compelling, polished digital experiences; personal branding and ownership of the work are highly valued.

• Familiarity with common software and system design patterns, APIs, cloud infrastructure, storage solutions, data structures, and related engineering concepts.

• Strong product mindset, with the ability to understand user problems, make thoughtful design decisions, and translate concepts into production-quality experiences.

• High degree of autonomy, ownership, curiosity, and comfort working in a fast-paced environment with minimal bureaucracy.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills when working across Engineering, Design, Growth, Sales, and other teams.

• A track record of solving challenging technical or product problems through projects, designs, GitHub contributions, or other demonstrable work. Formal degrees or certifications are not required.

• Experience building media, creative, or AI-powered products for enterprise customers is a plus.

Benefits

• Fully remote work, with the opportunity to work from Canada or other supported locations.

• Access to a global, diverse team and the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals across multiple regions.

• Annual discretionary professional development stipend to support learning and career growth.

• Annual discretionary stipend for meeting and connecting with colleagues in person.

• Annual company-wide offsite in a different international location.

• Monthly coworking stipend for employees who are not located near a main office hub.

• High-autonomy, AI-first culture focused on rapid experimentation and meaningful impact.

• Flexible opportunities to work across teams and projects according to your strengths and interests.

• Opportunity to work on cutting-edge generative AI products reaching millions of users.

• Significant influence over product direction, technical solutions, and the future of AI-powered creative experiences.

Join Nortal for your next big adventure. We are seeking a  Senior UX/UI Product Designer to join our team, grow with us, and teach us a few things along the way.

Why join Nortal

• Say Goodbye to Micromanagement:  We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values.

• Outcomes Over Hours:  We believe in a work model focused on impact, providing you with the flexibility to balance your professional success with your personal well-being.

• Vibrant Community:  Join our close-knit LATAM remote team and connect through tech talks, virtual coffee breaks, and team-building activities.

• Support from Day One:  Our People Care team is here to support you throughout your journey, from wellness check-ins to professional growth.

Our benefits  ✨

• Competitive USD salary.

• 100% remote work:  While you can work from anywhere, you’re always welcome to connect with teammates and grow your network at our coworking spaces across LATAM.

• Paid off & national holidays:  Take the time you need according to your country’s regulations while receiving your full salary.

• Sick leave:  Focus on your health without stress. Take the necessary time to recover and feel better.

• Annual credit:  Spend it on the perks you love to enhance your work-life balance.

• Team-building activities:  Join us for coffee breaks, tech talks, and after-work gatherings to bond with your Nortal family and feel part of our vibrant community.

• Birthday off:  Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family.

About the project

As a Senior UX/UI – Product Designer , you will will generate concepts and digital experiences that raise the bar, work closely with developers to ensure seamless fit and finish, and serve as a senior design voice within the team — mentoring peers, presenting to leadership, and contributing to the evolution of the design system.

What you’ll do

• Develop and deliver designs from initial concepts and wireframes to pixel-perfect final designs across web and mobile.

• Lead and participate in creative brainstorming sessions, shaping the direction of a wide range of digital experiences.

• Champion mobile-first, user- centered design principles and inspire the team to continuously raise the bar.

• Contribute to and help evolve a best-in-class design system, ensuring consistency and scalability across digital touchpoints.

• Present design concepts and clearly articulate design rationale to cross-functional stakeholders and senior leadership.

• Partner with developers to ensure designs are implemented with seamless fit and finish.

• Create interactive prototypes and micro-animations that communicate design intent and enhance user engagement.

• Work closely with the research team to understand user needs and validate design decisions before and after development.

• Design experiences for global audiences, considering localization and translation needs.

• Collaborate with the Brand team and other product design teams to ensure cohesive brand integration.

• Analyze current UX patterns and competitive design landscapes to inform design decisions.

• Mentor junior designers and contribute to elevating overall design quality within the team.

What makes you a great fit  🎯

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

• 5+ Years of experience designing for large-scale and high-visibility websites or digital products.

• Strong background in digital design and marketing, preferably with experience in marketing or communications.

• A hybrid skill set combining visual design and UX expertise.

• Advanced proficiency with design and prototyping tools: Figma, Adobe Illustrator, and Adobe Photoshop.

• Experience designing across multiple devices — mobile, tablet, and desktop.

• Experience presenting ideas and design solutions to senior leadership.

• Experience working in fast-paced, iterative design environments.

• Exceptional attention to detail and a strong sense of craftsmanship.

• A strong portfolio showcasing clean, thoughtful, and inspiring design work.

• Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and take initiative on complex design challenges.

• Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons. 

Global Impact, Local Culture 🌍

For over 25 years, we’ve been shaping digital transformation, delivering complex solutions for global enterprises and public sector organizations. Today, we are at the forefront of an AI-driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future.   

We believe complexity doesn’t have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That’s why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business-critical initiatives.  

Apply now and let’s shape the future of technology together!  🧑‍💻

At Code and Theory, Designers shape identity systems, campaigns, and digital product experiences that help brands feel distinct and relevant. We’re looking for a Senior Designer with strong visual instincts, sharp craft, and most importantly, deep AI fluency and prototyping momentum: someone who uses AI to think faster, make more, and close the gap between concept and build.

This role is for someone who cares deeply about typography, layout, interaction, motion, and the details that make work feel clear, expressive, and culturally aware. You’re excited to build brands that scale from foundational identity systems to campaign concepts and into real, shippable product experiences and you’re genuinely obsessed with emerging AI tools, building custom workflows, and using them to expand exploration, speed iteration, and raise the fidelity of what you hand to engineering.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Design across brand identity systems, campaigns, and digital product experiences (web, mobile, platforms)

• Create scalable visual languages and design systems that work across marketing and product environments

• Translate strategy into clear concepts, flows, UI frameworks, and high-craft executions

• Prototype early and often from interaction/motion studies to clickable and high-fidelity prototypes that reduce ambiguity and accelerate delivery

• Use AI as a core design tool, not an add-on: build and refine workflows for ideation, iteration, production support, and rapid prototyping

• Partner with strategists, writers, producers, and engineers to bring work to life end-to-end, with an emphasis on feasibility and build-ready detail

• Present work clearly, incorporate feedback thoughtfully, and contribute to client conversations when needed

• Balance conceptual exploration with strong day-to-day design production across multiple workstreams

• Deliver high-fidelity concepts that developers can build from ensuring what ships looks and behaves like what was intended (handoff, QA, iteration)

• Manage workload and project timelines to keep design work prioritized, scoped appropriately, and delivered on schedule

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

• High AI fluency and curiosity: you’re not just familiar with tools you’re actively experimenting, developing opinions, and evolving your workflow

• The ability to turn ideas into tangible, testable experiences quickly, using prototypes to drive alignment and decisions

• Strong communication skills, collaborative mindset, and ability to own pieces of work independently

• A portfolio showing strong craft across identity, campaign, and product/UI work (systems + execution)

• Strong typography, composition, interaction sensibility, and systems thinking with high attention to detail

• Experience contributing to design systems and applying them across both marketing and product surfaces

• Comfort collaborating closely with engineers (handoff, feasibility, QA) and working in iterative build cycles

ABOUT US

Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Create Group, Current, and TrueLogic.

Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel & hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J.P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok.

The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2,000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We’re always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward-thinking people to join our team.

The compensation range for this role is $90,000 – $115,000 and spans multiple levels. We're open to hiring at the level that best matches the right candidate's experience. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, budget, and location.
